key_fields.name: WS-EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD
key_fields.meaning: Date under edit, split into century, year, month and day with numeric redefinitions; loaded by the caller before PERFORM EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD.

key_fields.name: WS-VALID-FEB-DAY
key_fields.meaning: Day 1 through 28; defined but not tested by CSUTLDPY.

key_fields.name: WS-EDIT-DATE-FLGS
key_fields.meaning: Year, month and day result flags (LOW-VALUES valid, '0' not ok, 'B' blank); group 88 WS-EDIT-DATE-IS-VALID / WS-EDIT-DATE-IS-INVALID. COACTUPC copies it into the per-date flag groups.

key_fields.name: WS-DATE-VALIDATION-RESULT
key_fields.meaning: Result block returned by CALL 'CSUTLDTC': severity, message number, result text, tested date and mask.

key_fields.name: WS-CURRENT-DATE
key_fields.meaning: Current date and its INTEGER-OF-DATE value used by the date-of-birth check.

observations.text: Only centuries 19 and 20 are valid; years from 2100 onward are rejected.
CSUTLDPY's header says the accompanying working storage is 'CSUTLDTR', but the working storage actually copied is CSUTLDWY.

purpose: Working-storage copybook (level-10 items, copied inside a caller's 05 group) that supports the CSUTLDPY date edit paragraphs: the CCYYMMDD date under edit with century/month/day 88-levels, per-part result flags, binary dates for the not-in-future check, and the parameter block for CALL 'CSUTLDTC'. COACTUPC copies it inside WS-MISC-STORAGE; COTRTUPC also copies it.
